description: The `Microsoft.Extensions.AI` abstraction for chat models, with `GetResponseAsync` and `GetStreamingResponseAsync`, implemented by provider libraries.
A chain of delegating chat clients added with `Use*` calls, such as caching, function invocation, logging and OpenTelemetry, wrapped around a provider client.
A library that exposes a vendor SDK as an `IChatClient`, such as `AsIChatClient()` in `Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI`.
Letting the model request a .NET method described with `AIFunctionFactory.Create`, which `UseFunctionInvocation()` runs before returning the final answer.
A service that keeps no conversation, so the caller sends the full message history, including earlier responses, on every request.
The successor of Semantic Kernel and AutoGen for multi-step, goal-directed agents and workflows, built on the same provider abstractions.
